mapper.insert:
insert into project (name, customer_dev, is_platform_publish, is_with_goal, priority, type, status, pm, pm_id, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, `desc`, level, resource_assessment, pj_establish_start_date, pj_establish_publish_date, is_acceptance, create_man_id, create_man, parent_ids) values (#{name}, #{customerDev}, #{isPlatformPublish}, #{isWithGoal}, #{priority}, #{type}, #{status}, #{pm}, #{pmId}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{desc}, #{level}, #{resourceAssessment}, #{pjEstablishStartDate}, #{pjEstablishPublishDate}, #{isAcceptance}, #{createManId}, #{createMan},
concat(',', (select `AUTO_INCREMENT` from information_schema.TABLES where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'info_forward' and TABLE_NAME = 'project'), ','))

INSERT INTO project
`name`, inner_type, `level`, `desc`, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, pm, pm_id, valid_stages, create_man_id, create_man, expected_income, category, parent_ids
VALUES
#{name}, #{innerType}, #{level}, #{desc}, #{planStartDate}, #{planEndDate}, #{pm}, #{pmId}, #{validStages}, #{createManId}, #{createMan}, # 新增可选 #{expectedIncome}, #{category}, # 获取当前自增id concat(',', (select `AUTO_INCREMENT` from information_schema.TABLES where TABLE_SCHEMA = 'info_forward' and TABLE_NAME = 'project'), ',')
mapper.select: select * from project where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false

select a.id, a.name, a.customer_dev, a.priority, a.type, a.status, a.pm_id, a.pm, a.plan_start_date, a.plan_end_date, a.actual_start_date, a.actual_end_date, a.`desc`, a.create_man_id, a.create_man, a.create_date, a.modify_date from project a left join project_product_demand b on a.id = b.project_id and b.is_deleted = false where b.product_demand_id = #{productDemandId} and a.is_deleted = false
select * from project where name = #{name} and is_deleted = false

select pj.id, pj.name, pj.customer_dev, pj.priority, pj.type, pj.status, pj.pm, pj.pm_id, pj.plan_start_date, pj.plan_end_date, pj.actual_start_date, pj.actual_end_date, pj.`desc`, pj.is_deleted, pj.create_man_id, pj.create_man, pj.create_date, pj.modify_man_id, pj.modify_man, pj.modify_date from person p join project pj on p.main_id = pj.id join project_product_line ppl on pj.id = ppl.project_id where p.user_id = #{userId} and pj.status != 40 and pj.status != -20 and ppl.product_line_id = #{productLineId}
mapper.update: update project set status = #{status}, actual_start_date = #{actualStartDate}, actual_end_date = #{actualEndDate}, modify_man_id = #{modifyManId}, modify_man = #{modifyMan} where id = #{id} and is_deleted = false
mapper.select: select id, name, pm_id from project where status in (10, 20, 30) and is_deleted = false
select id, name, status from project where name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and is_deleted = false
